newsitem.title: FRANCE: France says Robien law protecting jobs.
newsitem.headline: France says Robien law protecting jobs.

text.p: France's Robien law, aimed at protecting jobs by reducing social security charges on companies that cut work hours to preserve jobs, has led to the signing of 40 accords affecting 6,500 workers, the Labour Ministry said on Monday.
It said another hundred or so deals affecting 13,000 workers were in the process of finalisation.

"The average job-creation comes to 14 percent, although the legal minimum is 10 percent," the ministry said in a statement marking the latest accord signed today with the company Villages Vacances Famille.
The company agreed to reduce work hours by 10 percent to create 173 new jobs, representing a 10 percent increase in its workforce.
